A  [[Jingle Bear]] is a [[charmable animal]] found within [[Gwen's garden]] after completion of the [[Snowball Dominance]].

==Locations==
*[[Core]]
**[[The Battle Isles]]
***{{NPC location|Zaishen Menagerie Grounds}} (levels 5, 12, 15, and 20, depending on unlock progress)
*[[Eye of the North]]
**[[Far Shiverpeaks]]
***{{NPC location|Ice Cliff Chasms}} (in [[Gwen's garden]] after completing [[Snowball Dominance]])

== Notes ==
* Unlike other charmable animals, the Jingle Bear cannot be attacked and doesn't attack when attempting to [[Charm Animal|charm]] it.
* The Jingle Bear appears without any cubs in the Zaishen Menagerie Grounds.
* Jingle Bears deal [[slashing damage]].
* [[Zaishen_Menagerie_Grounds/Service_costs|Unlocking cost]]: 2{{zgold}} plus 100{{gold}} or 20,000 [[Balthazar Faction]] ''(Prestige, Tyria).''
* A single Jingle Bear can be captured in Gwen's garden at any time, once the quest requirements have been met. You must [[zone|rezone]] if you wish more than one member of your party to obtain one.
*The bells on its collar faintly ring as the pet moves.

{{anomaly| The Jingle pets will appear if at least one player in the party has completed the relevant quests.}}
{{anomaly| If you have started the 2009 quest chain, the Jingle Bear won't show up until after you complete it (as the quest themselves affect the area's spawns).}}
{{anomaly| If you completed the quest chain in 2008, the Jingle Bear may not show up in 2009.}}

==Trivia==
*The Jingle Bear was introduced in [[Wintersday 2008]].
*This NPC shares the same model used for [[Ursula the White]] and the [[Miniature Polar Bear]].
*Prior to [[Wintersday 2010]], completion of the three [[Wintersday 2009#Quests|Wintersday quests]] given by [[Lieutenant Thackeray]] was the method to gaining access to the Jingle Bear and [[White Jingle Moa]].
